models.what_changed: Weights are Project Maya's Maya-M quant of GLM-5.3-Flash, unchanged. Adds a 2.2 MB vector (3 refusal directions per layer, layers 1 to 44) and a Maya engine patch that removes them at run time.

Weights are ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO quants of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, unchanged. Adds one 480 KB control vector, the refusal direction taken from huihui-ai's abliterated checkpoint, that the Strata engine subtracts at run time.

Refusal directions removed from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 by abliteration (huihui-ai, llama.cpp cvector method). Several series are built on ISTA-DASLab and unsloth quants of the same model.

Refusal directions removed from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B by abliteration (huihui-ai; layers 22 to 52 on the newer series). Also ships patch files that apply the change to unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF quants, and series built from community fine-tunes.
